title: Seawater Aqueous Speciation and Saturation Indices
description: Standard seawater geochemical speciation deck at 25 C and pH 8.1 computing ionic strength, carbonate alkalinity, and aragonite/calcite saturation state.
code:
TITLE Standard Seawater Aqueous Speciation at 25 C
# Major ion composition of standard mean ocean water (SMOW)
SOLUTION 1 Standard Seawater
    temp      25.0
    pH        8.1
    pe        8.45
    units     mmol/kgw
    Na        468.0
    Mg        53.2
    Ca        10.3
    K         10.2
    Cl        546.0
    S(6)      28.2
    C(4)      2.3

END

title: Calcite-CO2-Water Equilibrium and Karst Dissolution
description: Open-system carbonate geochemistry modeling rainwater equilibration with soil CO2(g) and limestone aquifer calcite dissolution kinetics.
code:
TITLE Calcite-CO2-Water Equilibrium and Karst Limestone Dissolution
SOLUTION 1 Recharge Rainwater
    temp      15.0
    pH        5.6 charge
    pe        4.0
    units     mmol/kgw
    Ca        0.1
    C(4)      0.2

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Calcite   0.0 10.0
    CO2(g)    -2.5 10.0

KINETICS 1
    Calcite
        -m0     5.0
        -m      5.0
        -parms  1.5e-6 12.0
    -steps 7200 in 12 steps

END

title: Acid Mine Drainage Neutralization with Limestone Titration
description: Remediation of acidic iron- and sulfate-rich mine drainage (pH 2.8) via stepwise CaCO3 limestone addition and gypsum/ferrihydrite mineral precipitation.
code:
TITLE Acid Mine Drainage Neutralization with Limestone Titration
SOLUTION 1 Acid Mine Drainage
    temp      20.0
    pH        2.8
    pe        10.0
    units     mmol/kgw
    Fe        8.5
    Ca        4.0
    Mg        2.5
    S(6)      15.5 charge
    Cl        1.5

REACTION 1
    CaCO3     1.0
    0.03 moles in 10 steps

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Gypsum    0.0 0.0
    Calcite   0.0 0.0

END

title: 1D Advective-Dispersive Reactive Ion-Exchange Column
description: One-dimensional reactive transport simulation of CaCl2 brine displacing Na-K groundwater through a 20-cell cation-exchange aquifer column.
code:
TITLE 1D Advective-Dispersive Reactive Ion-Exchange Column
SOLUTION 0 Influent CaCl2 Brine
    temp      25.0
    pH        7.0
    pe        4.0
    units     mmol/kgw
    Ca        1.2
    Cl        2.4

SOLUTION 1 Background Na-K Aquifer Water
    temp      25.0
    pH        7.2
    pe        4.0
    units     mmol/kgw
    Na        1.0
    K         0.2
    Cl        1.2

MIX 1
    0 0.5
    1 0.5

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Calcite   0.0 5.0

END

title: Geothermal Silica Scaling with Custom Mineral Database
description: High-enthalpy geothermal brine cooling and amorphous silica/calcite scaling kinetics paired with a companion custom thermodynamic mineral database (.dat).
code:
TITLE High-Temperature Geothermal Brine Silica Scaling and Mixing
SOLUTION 1 Deep Reservoir Brine
    temp      180.0
    pH        6.8
    pe        -2.0
    units     mmol/kgw
    Na        42.0
    K         4.5
    Ca        1.8
    Cl        46.0
    S(6)      1.2
    C(4)      3.5
    Si        8.2

SOLUTION 2 Reinjection Condensate
    temp      70.0
    pH        7.4
    pe        4.0
    units     mmol/kgw
    Na        5.0
    Cl        5.0
    C(4)      0.5

MIX 1
    1 0.8
    2 0.2

EQUILIBRIUM_PHASES 1
    Quartz    0.0 10.0
    Calcite   0.0 5.0

KINETICS 1
    Quartz
        -m0     1.0
        -m      1.0
        -parms  2.4e-7 5.0
    -steps 10800 in 12 steps

END
